name: Pool Deck Cheese or Prosciutto Pizza (Pinocchio's / Daisy's)
brandOrRestaurant: Disney Wonder & Magic · Pinocchio's Pizzeria / Disney Treasure · Daisy's Pizza Pies
whyItWorks: Soft, chewy white-flour crust with melted mozzarella or prosciutto is a fast pool-deck fuel option on steady/good days.
prepOrOrderInstructions: Choose Classic Cheese, Four-Cheese, or Prosciutto pizza (ask for light red sauce or white cheese base if tomato acidity bothers you, and take a Lactaid pill). Skip pepperoni grease or veggie slices with bell pepper skins during flares.
watchOuts: Greasy pepperoni or raw bell pepper/onion toppings
